node.statement: Let e_H^r>0 and e_quot^r>0 be the universal cutoffs supplied respectively by lem-stage1-quotient-left-inversion and lem-stage1-quotient-manifold-package, and let the other positive universal quantities be those supplied by lem-stage1-polar-constant-ledger and lem-stage1-uniform-inversion-isolation. In the root existential construction choose, explicitly and independently of any sibling, e_idx^r=min{C_rect*e_S1,e_iso^r,e_H^r,e_quot^r}. Every entry of this finite minimum is positive, so e_idx^r>0; moreover e_idx^r<=e_H^r and e_idx^r<=e_quot^r. Hence 0<=epsilon_r<=e_idx^r implies simultaneously epsilon_r<=e_H^r and epsilon_r<=e_quot^r.
